Chinese American Experiences Mass. Memories Road Show

collection

Chinese American Experiences Mass. Memories Road Show is a digital collection of items (photographs, documents, video interviews) contributed by community members. These materials were collected during a participatory archiving event held at the Pao Arts Center in Chinatown on June 2, 2018.
